name: Orange Sky Golden Harvest Entertainment (Holdings) Limited
summary: Orange Sky Golden Harvest Entertainment (Holdings) Limited is an investment holding company in the film business, active in Hong Kong, the mainland, Singapore and Taiwan. Based in Wan Chai since its 1970 founding, it produces and distributes films and television programs, and exhibits films in its own cinemas. It also earns from live shows, clubhouses, advertising and consultancy, and was previously Golden Harvest Entertainment (Holdings) Limited.
